verdicts.reason: Candidate A keeps a readable left-to-right flow (logo, can, headline, CTA). But the headline is jammed against the top edge, and the SUNSET SALE ribbon crowds the headline and the CTA. The badge row breaks: SMALL BATCH drops to its own line, offset under the CTA. The CTA nearly touches the right edge, and the missing-asset placeholder sits awkwardly near it. Candidate B is worse. Its oversized headline is crammed against the top and right edges and swamps everything else, and the can shrinks into the bottom-left corner. The badges and the SUNSET SALE tag are scattered as loose fragments. The body copy is tiny and squeezed into a narrow column, and the legal text is crammed beside the placeholder, so the layout looks jumbled.
